# Lotka-Volterra predator-prey {#sec-lv-predP}

{{< include ../preamble.qmd >}}

## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}

## Formal {.unnumbered}

$$
    \left\{
    \begin{aligned}
    \frac{d N}{dt} = r N - a N P \\
    \frac{d P}{dt} = \beta a N P - d P
    \end{aligned}
    \right.
$${#eq-lotka-volterra-preyP}

```{r}
params <- c(r = 1.0, a = 0.1, beta = 0.8, d = 0.5)
initial <- c(N = 10, P = 2)

lotka_volterra <- function(t, y, p) {
  N <- y[1]
  P <- y[2]
  c(
    p["r"] * N - p["a"] * N * P,
    p["beta"] * p["a"] * N * P - p["d"] * P
  )
}

rk4_step <- function(y, t, dt, f, p) {
  k1 <- f(t, y, p)
  k2 <- f(t + dt / 2, y + dt * k1 / 2, p)
  k3 <- f(t + dt / 2, y + dt * k2 / 2, p)
  k4 <- f(t + dt, y + dt * k3, p)
  y + dt * (k1 + 2 * k2 + 2 * k3 + k4) / 6
}

times <- seq(0, 50, by = 0.01)
solution <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(times), ncol = 2)
solution[1, ] <- initial
for (i in seq_len(length(times) - 1)) {
  solution[i + 1, ] <- rk4_step(solution[i, ], times[i], times[i + 1] - times[i], lotka_volterra, params)
}

N <- solution[, 1]
P <- solution[, 2]

par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))
plot(times, N, type = "l", col = "blue", lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Time", ylab = "Population",
     main = "Prey and Predator over Time")
lines(times, P, col = "red", lwd = 2)
legend("topright", legend = c("Prey (N)", "Predator (P)"),
       col = c("blue", "red"), lwd = 2, bty = "n")

plot(N, P, type = "l", col = "darkgreen", lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Prey (N)", ylab = "Predator (P)",
     main = "Phase Plane (Limit Cycle)")
points(N[1], P[1], pch = 16, col = "black")
text(N[1], P[1], labels = "Start", pos = 4, cex = 0.8)
```
